dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent network of irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by high-intensity light perimeters that transition sharply from the darker base pelage, forming a complex reticulated pattern across the dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity dark pixel clusters situated within the lighter annuli; a localized concentration of saturated high-intensity specular pixels exists on the upper dorsal curve, creating a high-contrast zone that obscures underlying texture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most distinct closed 'O' annuli on the upper mid-body form an irregular quadrilateral; a secondary triangular spatial relationship is formed by three prominent dark spots located just posterior to the left pectoral flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive specular glare along the longitudinal dorsal axis resulting in pixel saturation and localized loss of topological feature resolution.
